title: Tighten the Gaussian exterior-period debit at the expanded #8078 resource point
body:
## Verified scoped result

The literal exterior period uses q = 4⌈M/(4s′)⌉. Pricing the actual ceiling on the two cases around x = M/(4s′) = 256 yields q s′/M ≤ **257/256**. The source keeps its actual period, exterior routes, signed native words, typed owners, returns and recovery. Only the directed bound on the period cost changes, so the complete Gaussian debit can fall from 64939/524288 to **64934/524288**. The next lower tick 64933/524288 fails the same directed envelope.

At exact [#8078](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/b72d3fa097d2521939f6b8536029da674648d863)'s resource point, the fully replayed profile books **κ = 0.0038983400039**, an exact increase of **39/10^13** over 0.00389834, or **(39/389834000)%** displayed as **+0.00000010004258%**. It clears #8078's exact stopped Gaussian ceiling under the older cap. Moving 180 ordinary levels between stages preserves their sum. The smaller Gaussian debit funds the new target at G=978537, and the adjacent lower Gaussian height fails. Compared with #8078, this profile reduces complete recurring log₂ C by 9900 to **413717311**, reduces maximum native height by 45, and activates at 2^1599128+2. Entry conversion costs 717 units and fixed serial setup stays below 2^228. [Proof and directed controls](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/28926ef5702071cc952ebd7a36d855ac322d97ad/research/p104-expanded-period-debit/PROOF.md)

## Comparable frontier and overlap

The newer [#8081 at 51011382](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/510113821774bb27f7ddaad4e8b94837a1c2cf52) was independently reproduced at **κ = 0.00389846** at recurring log₂ C **4354317571** and maximum native height **18845936** with a charged 25-bit installer. The exact independent replay passed all eight registered scopes in 238.95 s, exit 0. Its exact hosted scientific job also executed all eight scopes. This proposal supplies a resource-scoped improvement over #8078. Its κ stays below #8081 by exactly **1199961/10^13**, a relative difference of **−(1199961/389846000)%**. [#8081 scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45114926967/job/137496902866)

[#8082](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8082) changes the ordinary summation reserve and the booking grid. [#8083](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8083) changes the matched Gaussian suffix. Its exact integral proof retains the exterior multiplier 1+1032/263772. The new period proof instead changes this multiplier for the actual four-aligned exterior period. [Pinned #8083 factor formula](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dd2e2ff28102557f7c30619d6abd8a861e363d1d/research/p104-integrated-gaussian-suffix/INTEGRAL.md#L55)

[#8084](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8084) supplies a separate ordinary component and an enlarged installer scope. Its existing Gaussian trial cannot fund the stated 0.0039 target.

## Reproduce

Use a clean checkout of 28926ef5702071cc952ebd7a36d855ac322d97ad and CPython 3.12 on POSIX.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-expanded-period-debit
```

The exact detached local checkout passed all seven signed modes in 243.97 s, exit 0. The registration's scoped task outcome is partial. All seven candidate modes actually ran. Independent source binding, exact invoices, old ceiling and decoder fault controls passed, including wrong period phase, wrong sign, equal-delay admission and missing native close. Local onboarding passed 760 tests with 31 skips, and the declared historical scope passed 19 controls. The exact submitted head passed all three hosted jobs in 650 s from scheduling. In the scientific job all seven actual scopes passed in 287 s of replay. The declared task outcome is partial, with all candidate scopes executed.
